Acidic, doused robes constrict your body, searing flesh with a deliberate and methodical intensity. Your sizzling sacrifice serves as a morbid source of delight for the ravenous spectators.

Cast down from the highest perch, your body crashes upon the unforgiving sandstone floor, a grotesque spectacle of entangled feathers and melted wax.
With one eye barely clinging to your ravaged face, you realize the thunderous crowd is cheering your name. Your departure from this mortal plane is met with resounding approval.
